checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'post-templates'.
templates/ contains story-engagement-sequence.md, countdown-launch-story.md, value-carousel.md, myth-buster-carousel.md, skills-roundup-carousel.md, and quote-inspiration-carousel.md.

checks.description: Templates use placeholders for campaign variables, never baked specifics.
checks.rule: Each template uses placeholders such as [KEYWORD], [OFFER], [INSTRUCTOR], [CLASS TITLE] and bakes no real offer, price, instructor name, or Skill Path title.

checks.description: Templates provide structure and slots, not final captions, and never publish.
checks.rule: Each template defines a beat or slide order with copy-overlay and CTA slots, states captions are routed to copywriter-ar and copywriter-en, and that publishing is a human-gate action.

checks.description: Interactive mechanics and CTA keyword are slots, never baked into art.
checks.rule: Where a poll, slider, countdown, or comment-to-DM keyword is used, the template marks space for the sticker and a [KEYWORD] slot rather than baking options or the keyword into the visual.

checks.description: Templates reference the brand visual constants, not the source's bright backgrounds.
checks.rule: Visual direction references #141414, #1A1A1A, and #009975 and does not adopt the orange, red, pink, or yellow backgrounds from the source doc by default.

checks.description: Arabic is never baked into a generated image.
checks.rule: Templates state that Arabic copy is an overlay slot filled by copywriter-ar and is never baked into a generated image.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the skill files.
checks.rule: No file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash, the U+0640 tatweel, or Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
